rows.text: 🔔 TOASTS KNOW THEIR PLACE — on phones they dock at the top, show one at a time, and step aside entirely while a board is open (everything still lands in the 🔔 tray). And they’re finally tappable : the › deep links work now.

rows.title: v1.7.2 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🛬 LAND WEARS THE GOLD — the survey card’s primary action stands out, every hint names the same landing verb, and the Sun is introduced as Sol, not “a sun-like star”.

rows.title: v1.7.2 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🛠 THE FABRICATOR ALWAYS HAS A VERB — unaffordable recipes show a disabled Craft button naming exactly what’s missing (“Need 3× Iron”), and every group shows its craftable count.

rows.title: v1.7.2 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: ⎋ ESCAPE CLOSES EVERYTHING — one press dismisses whichever board or dialog is on top, on every panel, even (safely) during training.

rows.title: v1.7.2 🎮 Gameplay
rows.text: 🎓 TRAINING IS REVERSIBLE — skipping now leads with “Keep Training” in gold, plain words explain you lose nothing, and Settings › Gameplay can restart the 21 lessons any time.

rows.title: v1.7.2 🎮 Gameplay
rows.text: 📖 A FRESH EXPEDITION SKIPS THE CHANGELOG — release notes greet returning explorers only; new pilots go straight to the stars.

rows.title: v1.7.2 🎮 Gameplay
rows.text: 🖱 PLANETS ARE EASIER TO CATCH — mouse clicks get the same forgiving pick radius touch always had, and an assisted landing announces itself.

rows.title: v1.7.2 🐛 Bug Fixes
rows.text: 🗒 the Expedition Journal reads “Mercury · Carbon world · 7/26” instead of “Mercurycarbon”, and the Planetside header names the world before its landing region.

rows.title: v1.7.2 🐛 Bug Fixes
rows.text: ☄ a comet’s tail no longer renders as a giant grey beam at planet zoom.

rows.title: v1.7.2 🐛 Bug Fixes
rows.text: 🏷 the ? button opens the Guide directly; the Star Atlas ✕ explains itself and removal can be undone; clearing notifications asks first; the notification badge clears when you read the tray.

rows.title: v1.7.2 🐛 Bug Fixes
rows.text: 📱 the top bar clears the Dynamic Island, panels keep their close buttons out of the status strip, and the name gate explains itself if a name can’t be used.

rows.title: v1.7.1 🐛 Bug Fixes
rows.text: 📱 THE PHONE SCREEN FITS AGAIN — on iPhone, typing your name (or searching) could make Safari zoom the whole page and never let go: your nameplate and HP slid off the top, panels spilled past the edges, the Shipyard’s ✕ went unreachable, and taps on planets landed beside them (training’s “tap Earth” included). The viewport is locked again and text fields no longer trigger the zoom. Pinch-zoom for accessibility still works — iOS never gives that up.

rows.title: v1.7.0 ✦ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 💎 ONE RARITY LADDER FOR EVERYTHING — ten tiers, Common to Transcendent, now grade every creature, plant, world, star, material and piece of gear the same way. And rarity is a discovery : a world hides its grade until you land, a star until you survey it — the reveal grows grander the rarer the find.

rows.title: v1.7.0 ✦ New Features & Systems
rows.text: ⛏ THE FULL MATERIALS ECONOMY — 47 materials across five families (structural, volatiles, precious, exotic, cosmic ), each with its own painterly icon, family-grouped in the hold. Exceptional ✦ units ride your ordinary stacks and forge finer gear.

rows.title: v1.7.0 ✦ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🌌 THE SEVEN COSMICS — Protomatter, Primordial Ice, Void Essence, Chronal Shard, Dark Matter seam only the deepest worlds; Stellar Plasma and Coronium are skimmed from the coronas of stars (☀ Skim, once your Jump Drive flies). All seven anchor endgame gear, and the Apex Court crowns await their collectors.

rows.title: v1.7.0 ✦ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🛠 THE FORGE — gear got the ARPG treatment: item windows with rarity frames and affix panels, equip and salvage side by side (a confirm guard if you want it, Salvage All for the junk), and the hold reborn as three tabs — Materials, Craftables, Gear.

rows.title: v1.7.0 ✦ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🛟 SAVE GUARDIAN — your save now keeps a last-known-good backup; if the primary is ever damaged, the game restores it automatically instead of starting you over.

rows.title: v1.7.0 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🧭 THE BRIDGE, REBUILT — ✦ Prime Codex holds the top center; 📜 Charters and 📖 Compendium stack the left rail, 🌍 Star Atlas and 🛠 Shipyard the right; 🏆 🔔 ? ⚙ sit as circles in the corner. On phones everything docks into two even rows at your thumbs, and every panel opens as a sheet above them.

rows.title: v1.7.0 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: ✨ QUIET SIGNALS — the open board glows gold instead of growing, status dots and number badges are retired (only Prime keeps its 0/9), and the HP bar reads like a gauge: quarter ticks, a lit edge, a bright tip.

rows.title: v1.7.0 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🎨 PANEL TINT — a Graphics slider sets how solid the glass panels pour; the character sheet fits phones so your inventory surfaces without a scroll.

rows.title: v1.7.0 🎮 Gameplay
rows.text: 🎓 TRAINING, GRADUATED — Field Training is 21 lessons and now ends the way an expedition begins: you open the 📜 board and accept your first charter. Nothing is ever accepted for you, and the ? Guide takes over from there.

rows.title: v1.7.0 🎮 Gameplay
rows.text: 🛬 EVERY DESCENT, A NEW FACE — the region you touch down in re-rolls on every landing, so returning to a world can find its deserts, jungles, or open seas.

rows.title: v1.7.0 🎮 Gameplay
rows.text: 🌊 THE DEEP IS ALIVE — abyssal dives and reef descents now swim with the world’s own aquatic species, and every vista plant is the true species from your Compendium — a desert’s cacti finally look like cacti.

rows.title: v1.7.0 ⚖ Balancing
rows.text: ⚔ FAIR MIRRORS — when two perfectly matched fighters meet, the first strike now falls by a fair seeded coin instead of always favoring the challenger.

rows.title: v1.7.0 ⚖ Balancing
rows.text: 🧬 BLOODLINES WITH A HORIZON — breeding and feeding still grow a champion without limit in spirit, but the deepest grinds now approach a ceiling (~2.5× a Titan) instead of dwarfing every fight in the game. No real bloodline in the wild loses a single point.

rows.title: v1.7.0 ⚖ Balancing
rows.text: 🏋 POWER IS EARNED, NOT WORN — an item’s rarity is its story; its strength comes from tier and craftsmanship.

rows.title: v1.7.0 🐛 Bug Fixes
rows.text: 📌 a pinned recipe’s tracker chip no longer sits on top of the Compendium button.

rows.title: v1.7.0 🐛 Bug Fixes
rows.text: 🎓 restarting training after accepting a charter can no longer strand the final lesson.

rows.title: v1.7.0 🐛 Bug Fixes
rows.text: 🔵 veterans updating no longer see every long-catalogued species wearing the blue new-entry dot.

rows.title: v1.7.0 🐛 Bug Fixes
rows.text: 🛠 the Fabricator now says where every cosmic material is found, like the item cards always did.

rows.title: v1.7.0 🔧 Under the Hood
rows.text: 🔒 a full security hardening pass over saved data and share codes (two independent external reviews, every finding closed).

rows.title: v1.7.0 🔧 Under the Hood
rows.text: 📴 the game’s fonts now live inside the game — no outside requests, fully offline.

rows.title: v1.7.0 🔧 Under the Hood
rows.text: 🔋 hidden tabs stop rendering entirely; portrait memory is budgeted to the device; browser zoom is re-enabled.

rows.title: v1.7.0 🔧 Under the Hood
rows.text: 🧪 releases now gate themselves: the deploy refuses to ship unless the full test battery passes.

rows.title: v1.6.4 🐛 Bug Fixes
rows.text: 🛬 LANDING TRAINING UNSTUCK — for returning pilots who had already set foot on Earth, the Land step could light up but never complete (the descent registered, yet training didn’t move on). It now always advances. New pilots were never affected.

rows.title: v1.6.3 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🃏 SPECIMEN CARD, TIDIED — the action buttons are reordered (Breed · Feed · Duel · Scout · Code), and Rename moved to a small ✎ icon beside the name so the row stays clean.

rows.title: v1.6.3 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🧭 TRAINING OUT OF THE WAY — during the Compendium lesson the training card sits at the top, so the creature list below stays scrollable and reachable.

rows.title: v1.6.2 🐛 Bug Fixes
rows.text: 📱 THE BEGIN BUTTON STAYS IN VIEW — on short phones the intro’s name field and Begin button could sit below the bottom of the screen; they’re now pinned in place while the story scrolls above them.

rows.title: v1.6.2 🐛 Bug Fixes
rows.text: 🔢 CHARTER COUNTERS DON’T SPLIT — a charter’s progress count (like 0 / 2) no longer wraps onto two lines on narrow screens.

rows.title: v1.6.1 🐛 Bug Fixes
rows.text: 📖 THE BINDER OPENS AGAIN — the Compendium’s Binder view hit an error and refused to open; it works again.

rows.title: v1.6.1 🐛 Bug Fixes
rows.text: 🛡 SAVE INTEGRITY — loaded saves now clamp a creature’s bloodline values, so a tampered save can’t forge an impossibly powerful creature (or share one).

rows.title: v1.6.1 🐛 Bug Fixes
rows.text: 🏴 ONE WORLD, ONE REWARD — a rapid double-tap on a conquest can no longer pay its Stardust or count its win more than once.

rows.title: v1.6.1 🐛 Bug Fixes
rows.text: 🧬 BREEDING GUARD — the breeding core now refuses already-consumed parents, so a stray double-tap can’t spawn a phantom child.

rows.title: v1.6 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🎨 THE UNIVERSE, REPAINTED — every living thing is hand-painted now. The whole bestiary was redrawn by the game’s painterly canvas engine: no two clades share a silhouette, and a creature’s body tells you what it is at a glance.

rows.title: v1.6 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🌍 A PAINTED EARTH — all 631 of Earth’s real animals and 334 of its plants wear class-true forms — mammals, birds, fish, reptiles, amphibians, insects, arachnids, crustaceans, cephalopods, primates, bats, corals — each with the anatomy, eyes, and stance of its kind, its true name on the card.

rows.title: v1.6 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 👽 ALIEN LIFE, TRULY ALIEN — procedural creatures no longer share one template. Their genes draw real anatomy now: beaked, mandibled, frilled, tusked, or tendril-fringed heads; one to eight eyes; whip, finned, plumed, or stinger tails; two to eight limbs; and structural skins (scaled, furred, feathered, chitinous, plated, warty, translucent, crystalline). An ocean-dwelling species keeps its signature anatomy as a swimmer instead of collapsing into a generic fish.

rows.title: v1.6 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🏞 LANDING VISTAS — every world paints its biome as a living scene with its wildlife in habitat: reefs and abyssal deeps, jungle canopies, savannas, dunes, glaciers, ash wastes. Gas giants show native life drifting in the clouds; barren and toxic worlds stay honestly empty.

rows.title: v1.6 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🧬 THE LINEAGE CARD — bred hybrids carry an expandable family-tree lookup: “Bred from Lion (62% of traits) and Wolf (38%),” with a per-trait breakdown of where each feature came from (Body plan ← Lion, Tail ← Wolf). Cross away from Earth and the bloodline visibly drifts — alien features creeping onto the familiar frame.

rows.title: v1.6 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🏆 CHAMPION CODES — copy a 🏆 Champion code for any leveled creature and send it to a friend; they face it at its full strength in an exhibition duel. Same code, same creature, anywhere.

rows.title: v1.6 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: ✦ THE LOOT CHASE BEGINS — conquering a world can imbue a worn piece of gear with a seeded bonus stat (✦ +X%), and the deeper the world, the stronger the roll. Your equipment grows a character of its own.

rows.title: v1.6 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🌱 BIOSPHERE YIELD — a world’s wildlife is finite. Each biosphere offers only so many capture attempts before it is worked out, so where you hunt, and how, matters.

rows.title: v1.6 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🃏 ITEM CARDS — tap any item to open a card with its full stats and effects, and equip it straight from there.

rows.title: v1.6 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🐾 PORTRAITS WITH DEPTH — Compendium and survey portraits use the painterly engine end to end, so a specimen looks the same on its card, in its vista, and on the map.

rows.title: v1.6 🐾 Gameplay
rows.text: 🦋 CLASS ROUTING, HARDENED — a species is drawn as what it biologically is: a Butterflyfish is a fish, a Peacock Butterfly an insect, a Peacock a bird. Hundreds of name collisions were resolved so the catalogue reads true.

rows.title: v1.6 🔧 Under the Hood
rows.text: 🎨 ONE PAINTER FOR EVERYTHING — the entire visual layer runs through a single deterministic art engine; the same seed paints the same life on every device, and it ships without touching the universe’s determinism — share codes and cross-device parity are unchanged.

rows.title: v1.5.2c ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🔮 THE ELEMENTAL TITAN HUNT — the Prime Codex is nine elements now, each guarded by a unique, named titan (Terrakoth of Earth, Pyraxis of Fire, Nullreth of the Void…). Landing reveals whether a titan stands on this world; send your strongest champions to fell it and claim the element. The basics wait near home, Electric and Poison at mid range, Void and Prism far past the Deep Field.

rows.title: v1.5.2c ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🐾 TAME & SCAVENGE — life is no longer catalogued on sight. Landing surveys the biosphere; then 🐾 Tame a beast or 🌿 Scavenge a growth to enter it in your Compendium. Odds fall with rarity and rise with crafted gear.

rows.title: v1.5.2c ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🌍 THE CRADLE — Earth’s real animals and plants are your first catchable roster: named creatures clamped to starter grades and fighting at starter strength, their true names carried into the Compendium.

rows.title: v1.5.2c ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: ✦ MASTERING THE UNIVERSE — the story is retold end to end. The Prime Codex is the master survey; fell each element’s titan to master it; master all nine to open the Celestial Frontier. You cannot finish the infinite, only master it. (The old Pathfinder and beacon lore is retired.)

rows.title: v1.5.2c ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🛠 THE SHIPYARD — new right-rail screen for the ship: ship portrait that gains each built system, with the Fabricator and Research Bench beneath, recipes grouped by category. The character screen now holds only the explorer: figure, stats, and cargo hold.

rows.title: v1.5.2c ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🏆 THE RECORDS BOARD — rarity ladder and all achievement shelves moved from the character sheet into their own right-rail panel.

rows.title: v1.5.2c ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🛬 TRAINING LEARNS TO LAND — new Field Training lesson: press Land on Earth’s card (Earth never waves off) to open Planetside. Training is now 20 lessons covering chart, land, catalogue, feed, breed, duel, heal, and forge.

rows.title: v1.5.2c ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: ⛏ THE DRILLS RUN THEMSELVES — Mine is a toggle: one press starts continuous mining; press again to stop, or mining ends when the vein runs dry.

rows.title: v1.5.2c ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🗺 THE SOL TOUR — five new starter charters covering the home system: first landings on Mercury, Mars, the gas giants, and the outer system, plus crafting a working component. Each pays on completion; finishing the tour opens the weekly board.

rows.title: v1.5.2c ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🎒 THE PACK ON YOUR BACK — the Module socket is now worn gear (ship systems live at the Shipyard); slotting a pack module adds a visible row of cargo slots per tier.

rows.title: v1.5.2c 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🎒 THE HOLD IS A BAG — inventory is a Diablo-style slot grid under the portrait, empty slots included, so remaining capacity is always visible.

rows.title: v1.5.2c 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 📊 STAT BARS ON THE SHEET — the explorer’s five battle stats use the same bar rendering as specimen cards.

rows.title: v1.5.2c 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: ⬆ GATED STAR CHARTERS — foreign-galaxy stars beyond your ring now name the required build (the Intergalactic Drive) on their charter row, from any ring.

rows.title: v1.5.2c 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🎽 EQUIP PICKER — opens below its socket (socket stays visible and tappable) and carries a ✕; an empty socket’s hint is no longer a dead end.

rows.title: v1.5.2c 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🔤 ONE FOLD LANGUAGE — every collapsible header uses the world card’s expand/close pill (replacing arrow glyphs); the Compendium opens with its first occupied shelf expanded; battle stats render as plain bars (definitions live in the Guide); Mega Fauna matches its shelf-mates; specimen-card verbs sit in a grid.

rows.title: v1.5.2c 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🔭 NAMES ARE NAMES — map labels drop parentheses and glyphs: Pluto, comets, and moons show bare names; type details live on the card. Ring systems no longer clip square at the sprite edge on wide-band worlds.

rows.title: v1.5.2c 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: ✕ EVERY PANEL’S CLOSE — stays pinned to the top corner while the list beneath it scrolls.

rows.title: v1.5.2c 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🧭 CHARTERS MOVE TO THE LEFT RAIL — the Charters board (and the Chapters spine atop it) take the left rail; the Prime Codex, your endgame, moves to the top-right gold pill.

rows.title: v1.5.2c 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🐾 THE LIFE FORMS MENU — a surveyed world’s roster now folds behind the card’s expand/close pill, with its 🐾 Tame and 🌿 Scavenge actions grouped inside, beside the creatures they draw from.

rows.title: v1.5.2c 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: ✕ THE SETTINGS CLOSE, CLEANED — the menu’s ✕ is a clean corner glyph now, not a filled box over the panel.

rows.title: v1.5.2c 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🎨 THE NAMEPLATE MENU — Settings now has a Nameplate row that opens one editor for your name and your plate colour; the colour picker moved here from the character sheet, and the old redundant Explorer-name row is gone.

rows.title: v1.5.2c 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: ⚙ GRAPHICS TOOLTIPS — the Graphics toggles (visual effects, screen shake) carry tooltips now.

rows.title: v1.5.2c 🐛 Bug Fixes
rows.text: 🪐 THE MAP HOLDS WHILE YOU VISIT — landing on (or zooming in to) a world now freezes its orbit, so the planet stays framed under the camera and its survey card stops drifting across the screen; the sky resumes turning when you pull back out.

rows.title: v1.5.2c 🐛 Bug Fixes
rows.text: 🛬 PLANETSIDE HOLDS IN TRAINING — the landing-lesson vista no longer closes on its own; it waits for your tap to continue, exactly like live play.

rows.title: v1.5.2c 🐛 Bug Fixes
rows.text: ✎ LONG NAMES STAY IN THE PLATE — a long explorer name is trimmed with an ellipsis in the nameplate and on the character sheet instead of spilling out of the box.

rows.title: v1.5.2c 🐛 Bug Fixes
rows.text: ⚒ THE FORGE READS YOUR HOLD — the Fabricator’s craft buttons re-check what you can afford the moment new ore lands, so a recipe you can suddenly build lights up without reopening the Shipyard.

rows.title: v1.5.2c 🐛 Bug Fixes
rows.text: ⛏ DRILL CHARTERS COUNT AGAIN — mining charters tally each pull the drills make.

rows.title: v1.5.2c 🐛 Bug Fixes
rows.text: 🛠 SHIPYARD ALWAYS ON THE RAIL — the 🛠 button no longer disappears after training; the Shipyard is always one tap away.

rows.title: v1.5.2c ⚖ Balancing
rows.text: 🩸 MERCY, SHARPENED — the crawl-home mercy now applies only to bloodlines you bred (wild-born crossbreeds die on defeat), and fires once per mend: a champion fielded while still Critical does not crawl home twice. The same rule closes a reroll seam found in the audit — every retry past the first requires real mending.

rows.title: v1.5.2c ⚖ Balancing
rows.text: 🤝 WARY FIRST CONTACT — now follows the wave-off law: its automatic landing damage can take you to the brink but never kill. Deep-ring receptions still hit hard.

rows.title: v1.5.1 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🧍 THE PORTRAIT, REPAINTED — explorer figure redrawn with true proportions, jointed limbs, and a lit face behind the visor, staged on a landing pad under a ringed world.

rows.title: v1.5.1 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🎽 THE PICKER COMES TO YOUR THUMB — tapping a socket opens the gear list beside it instead of below the figure.

rows.title: v1.5.1 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🗂 ONE CARD GRAMMAR EVERYWHERE — specimen-card verbs moved above the stats (matching world cards); the character sheet’s nameplate colors, rarity ladder, and achievement shelves folded into Collection and Achievements groups. The left column is now four lines and three folds.

rows.title: v1.5.1 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 📱 PHONES BREATHE — the character screen stacks paperdoll, cargo, then stats on phones, putting the Fabricator directly below the sockets.

rows.title: v1.5.1 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: ⬆ THE CHARTER SPEAKS ON THE CARD — out-of-ring stars and galaxies state the gate and the required build on their survey card (“a view for now — the ⚡ Jump Drive opens this sky”). Viewing remains free everywhere.

rows.title: v1.5.1 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🛠 TRAINING LEARNS THE FORGE — nineteenth Field Training lesson: craft an Iron Plate at the real Fabricator using loaned ore from the 🧰 hold. Fully sandboxed — ore and plate return to the order on exit.

rows.title: v1.5.1 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: ⚔ THE QUEST SYSTEM — the mainline is renamed Chapters ; the charter board beneath it is now progressive.

rows.title: v1.5.1 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: ⚔ CHARTER CHAINS — charters arrive in chains (the five trades and the Sol tour), revealing one link at a time.

rows.title: v1.5.1 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: ⚔ ACCEPT TO ACTIVATE — a revealed charter tracks only after Accept (three active at once); a deed already done completes on the spot. The weekly board opens once the five trades are learned.

rows.title: v1.5.1 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🎒 CHARTERS PAY GEAR — five early links award a crafted piece on completion (headlamp, mag-boots, meteorite pendant, field leggings, comms earpiece), equipped straight into an empty socket. The Fabricator remains the upgrade path.

rows.title: v1.5.1 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🧭 NUDGES LEAD SOMEWHERE — the next-step nudge names the current chain link (accepted charter first, else the link awaiting Accept); tapping a guiding toast (marked ›) opens the Charters board.

rows.title: v1.5.1 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🧭 ARRIVAL PAYS — first arrival in a system with no prior expedition record logs a First Arrival line and pays +2 ☄ Stardust.

rows.title: v1.5.1 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🌸 THE CARD BLOSSOMS — orbit shows identity, a life-signature count, and a one-line environment summary; landing opens the environment fold, the biosphere survey, and the capture verbs.

rows.title: v1.5.1 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🐾 TAME & SCAVENGE — the biosphere survey reveals the roster instead of cataloguing it; each species is caught individually with visible odds (lower for rarer species, raised by crafted gear). Misses cost nothing; every Compendium page is earned.

rows.title: v1.5.1 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🔮 THE ELEMENTAL SIGNATURES — the Prime Codex is nine elements now, each ruled by a named titan (Terrakoth of Earth, Pyraxis of Fire, Nullreth of the Void…). The basics wait near home; Electric and Poison at mid range; Void and Prism far past the Deep Field. The beacon lore is retired — the elements are the arc.

rows.title: v1.5.1 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: ⚔ THE TITAN HUNT — each element’s Signature is guarded by a unique named titan, far mightier than any wild apex — the same creature for every explorer, seeded to its world. The Codex reads a resonance that names the KIND of world to hunt (molten worlds for Fire, the deep dark for the Void) and how far out it lies — tap a resonance in reach to track it and set a bearing for the titan’s nearest world. You won’t know a titan waits until you land and survey. Each titan wears its element and fights wrapped in it. Send your bred and tamed champions, fell it, and claim the element. Mine, craft, breed stronger, hunt the titans — the whole game meets here.

rows.title: v1.5.1 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🌍 THE CRADLE — Earth now carries a real, catchable biosphere from your first landing: land, survey, and tame or scavenge a full spread of beasts, birds, flora and microbes. Every one is a starter — grade capped at Uncommon, honest stat variance, no ceiling-breakers — so a menagerie on day one never becomes an early armory. Humanity stays on the card; the wildlife joins it.

rows.title: v1.5.1 ⚖ Balancing
rows.text: ⛏ THE MINING BURST — one press runs up to 10 pulls (~16s), then mining stops until pressed again. Prevents AFK reserve drain; burst-extending recipes are planned.

rows.title: v1.5.1 ⚖ Balancing
rows.text: ⬆ CHAPTER GOALS COUNT DEEDS — Chapter mining goals now count drill runs (one press = one deed) instead of loads; the hold and the charters still count every load.

rows.title: v1.5.1 ⚖ Balancing
rows.text: 👑 GUARDIANS HONOR THE DISTANCE — Apex Guardians now use the standard region scaling (+14% power per region out), matching ordinary apex defenders (in force since v1.4).

rows.title: v1.5.1 ⚖ Balancing
rows.text: 🛡 LEGENDS GROW WHERE THE WORLDS ARE RARER — conquest XP now scales with the conquered world’s tier; each genuinely new species catalogued grants the standing Field Scout +2 XP.

rows.title: v1.5.1 ⚖ Balancing
rows.text: 🩸 THE MERCY LAW REACHES CONQUEST — a fallen bred champion returns Critical instead of dying; champion duty can reduce you to the brink but never kill; below quarter health you cannot lead a conquest yourself (send a beast or mend first). Closes a death loop the 5,000-player synthetic panel hit 344 times. Wild-caught champions still die on defeat.

rows.title: v1.5.1 ⚖ Balancing
rows.text: 🌡 THE DEPTH TAX — field damage (bioscans, wary receptions) now scales with distance: softer than before in the home galaxy, plus a tax per universe region out, exceeding 2x at the Frontier. Displayed danger % is unchanged; only the damage is graded. Near home an ungeared explorer is near-safe; deep rings are where scouts, hulls, and suits matter.

rows.title: v1.5 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🌅 A FRESH START FOR EVERYBODY — all expeditions reset with v1.5; every explorer starts from the same Sol opening (the Ascent is now the canon start). Nothing is grandfathered or carried over; a farewell card records the retired expedition and its rarest find. The universe is untouched: same seeds, worlds, and share codes.

rows.title: v1.5 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🧍 THE CHARACTER SCREEN — one centered, Diablo-style home: full-length painterly explorer with nine gear sockets pinned to the body (Helmet, Earpiece, Necklace, Suit, Gloves, Tool, Leggings, Boots, plus the ship Module beside the figure); stats in the left column; Cargo hold, Fabricator, and Research Bench beneath. The 🧰 button shortcuts to inventory. Phones stack paperdoll, stats, then hold.

rows.title: v1.5 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: ✦ THE PATHFINDERS’ TRAIL — the Prime Codex is now the endgame arc, starting where the Ascent ends. Each Signature names its trail reach; claiming it recovers a relic blueprint — nine unique signature-tier gear pieces, one per socket, forgeable only at a Signature-holder’s Fabricator. A Legacy prestige layer for completing the Trail is planned.

rows.title: v1.5 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🧭 QUEST NOTIFICATIONS — a nudge on login and on idle points at the current chapter goal or charter; fires once per goal, never over another conversation; the 🔔 tray keeps a record.

rows.title: v1.5 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: ⚔ CHARTERS TAKE THE PRIME SLOT — Charters and the Ascent move to the gold pill (top right); the Prime Codex (endgame) moves to the left rail.

rows.title: v1.5 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🐾 SPECIMEN CARDS CONDENSED — identity and battle stats on top; the field-notes wall folds behind a remembered expand group with a one-line digest. Extremophile ⟁ headlines stay visible. Compendium shelf rows clamp to one line; the card holds the prose.

rows.title: v1.5 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🌙 QUIET SKIES FOR NOW — Cosmic Events and the Traveler’s Beacon are disabled pending rework; their achievements are shelved with them. They will return.

rows.title: v1.5 ⚖ Balancing
rows.text: 🛡 LEVELS YOU CAN ACTUALLY REACH — class level thresholds cut in half: level 3 at ~7 victories, level 6 a multi-session arc, level 9 the long chase. XP awards unchanged (duels +8, conquests +20, guardians +60). A 240-session synthetic panel found only 3% of sessions reached the second innate art on the old curve, and none reached the third.

rows.title: v1.5 🐛 Bug Fixes
rows.text: 🔔 NOTIFICATION TRAY — no longer overlaps the search box during Field Training; each lesson closes the panels the next lesson does not need.

rows.title: v1.5 🐛 Bug Fixes
rows.text: 📊 LANDING TALLIES — Groundfall and Trailblazer count again. The worlds-landed tally froze in v1.3.8 when landings stopped leaving space; it now ticks on the landing rite.

rows.title: v1.4 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: ⬆ THE ASCENT — three-chapter mainline pinned atop the Charters board. New expeditions start locked to Sol and mine → craft → build outward: the ⚡ Jump Drive opens the Neighborhood, the 📡 Long-Range Array opens the whole galaxy, the 🌌 Intergalactic Drive opens intergalactic space. The full sky stays visible from day one — looking is free, moving is earned. Veteran saves keep everything.

rows.title: v1.4 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🧰 THE FABRICATOR — crafting spine in the Cargo hold: T1 basic parts → T2 components → T3 ship systems and explorer gear; ~30 space-made recipes with painterly icons; no wait timers.

rows.title: v1.4 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🎽 EQUIPMENT — nine gear sockets on the character sheet (Helmet · Earpiece · Necklace · Suit · Gloves · Leggings · Boots · Tool · Module). Mining rigs and grip gloves multiply hauls; hazard suits open molten/crushing/frozen worlds; the Gravitic Anchor removes wave-offs; the Diplomat’s Beacon wins first contacts; grail pieces require biome-gated exotics.

rows.title: v1.4 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 📡 THE SHIPYARD — the character sheet shows the ship: a bare hull on chemical thrusters that visibly gains each built system (Jump Drive engines, Array dish, Auto-Extractor pod, Intergalactic outriggers).

rows.title: v1.4 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🗺 THE BEACON, RETUNED — the Traveler’s Beacon now always targets inside your current charter: Sol, then the Neighborhood, then the galaxy, then the wider cosmos.

rows.title: v1.4 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 💎 BIOME-GATED VEINS — the four exotics each have a source biome: Geode worlds carry Neodymium, Carbon worlds Promethium, Glass deserts Voidglass, magma seas Prismatium. The vein shows on the card with a ✦; every rich strike there hits it.

rows.title: v1.4 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: ⛏ MINING REBUILT — hourly timer removed. Each press pulls a variable haul; rich strikes hit rare pockets; reserves are finite — the card counts remaining pulls, and a world can be mined out (hundreds of pulls). The 🤖 Auto-Extractor keeps working every mined world while away.

rows.title: v1.4 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🏅 ACHIEVEMENTS & GUIDE — nine new Engineering achievements; two new Guide chapters (The Fabricator & gear · The Ascent).

rows.title: v1.4 ⚖ Balancing
rows.text: 🌈 THE RING SPECTRUM — find rarity caps expand with the rings: up to Legendary near home, Mythic in the home galaxy, one more band per region out, summit grades in the Deep Field. Bred bloodlines, guardians, and Paragons are exempt; existing catalogue entries never downgrade.

rows.title: v1.4 ⚖ Balancing
rows.text: 🌈 WORLDS & STARS — the same ladder applies to worlds and stars on new expeditions: spectral designations cap by ring, along with the spoils, veins, and reserves that scale on world tier. Existing expeditions keep every shown designation.

rows.title: v1.4 ⚖ Balancing
rows.text: 💚 MEDICINE NEVER KILLS — eating flora can reduce the explorer to 1 HP but can no longer end the expedition (beasts can still die of a bad meal — they have a keeper; you are the keeper). The 700-player synthetic panel found the heal button was the top cause of death.

rows.title: v1.4 ⚖ Balancing
rows.text: 🛠 GRAIL RECIPE SOURCES — grail recipes name their exotic’s source biome in the cost line (Neodymium reads “Geode worlds”, Prismatium “Magma seas”).

rows.title: v1.4 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🏞 PLANETSIDE — the landing view is renamed Planetside and is now a pop-up card over the game with its ✕ on the frame, not a separate full screen.

rows.title: v1.4 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: ⏭ DUEL SKIP — duels gain a ⏭ Skip button to jump straight to the outcome.

rows.title: v1.4 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🗂 COMPENDIUM SHELVES — unified naming: Land · Aerial · Aquatic · Amphibious · Cave · Extremophile Fauna (gas-giant floaters shelve under Aerial; each card names its precise realm).

rows.title: v1.4 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 📍 SURVEY CARD ANCHORING — cards stay beside their world through pan, zoom, and orbit drift.

rows.title: v1.4 🐛 Bug Fixes
rows.text: ☄ ASTEROID SPRITES — belt and outer-ring asteroids draw as shaded irregular lumps instead of squares, in close-up and card thumbnails.

rows.title: v1.4 🐛 Bug Fixes
rows.text: ❔ HELP POPOVER — tapping empty space closes the ? popover, matching every other panel.

rows.title: v1.4 🐛 Bug Fixes
rows.text: 🎲 TRAINING ROLLS — every practice roll succeeds, feeding included, on any step; a rig bug poisoned the loaned beast on every training meal.

rows.title: v1.3.10 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🗂 KINGDOM FILTERS — the Compendium sorts itself by kingdom now: filter chips (All · 🐾 Fauna · 🌿 Flora · 🍄 Fungi · 🦠 Microbes) sit above the shelves, and picking one throws open that kingdom’s shelves. Every shelf header wears its kingdom’s color for at-a-glance reading, filtered or not.

rows.title: v1.3.9 🐛 Bug Fixes
rows.text: 🎯 TRAINING TAP GUARD — during Field Training, tapping a world outside the lesson now does nothing at all. Before, a stray tap in the find-Earth step could lock another planet’s card for the rest of training — and stray taps could even dismiss the lesson’s own card.

rows.title: v1.3.8 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🛬 ORBITAL LANDING — the descent never leaves the sky: the camera holds at approach framing while the landing view opens over it. The old flat ground close-up is gone entirely — mining, census, samples, and first contact all still work from orbit, exactly as before.

rows.title: v1.3.8 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🏞 VISTA REBUILD — the Landing vista button works on any world you’ve visited, even after a reload; if this session hasn’t painted the scene yet, it’s rebuilt on the spot.

rows.title: v1.3.8 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: ✕ LANDING VIEW CLOSE — the ✕ shows everywhere now, training included, and the ? popover follows the one-panel rule (no more settings peeking out beneath it).

rows.title: v1.3.7 🐛 Bug Fixes
rows.text: 🎓 LESSON INPUT SCOPE — Field Training answers only the lesson in front of you: unrelated survey-card buttons (Land included) and specimen-card verbs go quiet, so the feeding lesson can never trip a live breeding roll — while folding rows and closing cards stay free.

rows.title: v1.3.7 🐛 Bug Fixes
rows.text: 🛬 LANDING VIEW BACKDROP — the landing view floats cleanly over open space; the extreme ground close-up no longer renders behind it.

rows.title: v1.3.6 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🔭 STAR CHARTS SETTING — a new Graphics toggle draws orbit paths, the habitable zone, and chart labels in system view. Ships off — flip it on for the full astronomy overlay.

rows.title: v1.3.6 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🤫 TRAINING HOVER QUIET — while a lesson is up, cursor sweeps no longer pop survey glances over the guidance card; only the lesson’s own target shows (Earth still glances in find-Earth).

rows.title: v1.3.6 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🖱 HOVER SCOPE — hover cards appear only at system scale, so sweeping across a galaxy no longer strobes a stream of star cards. A tap still opens anything, anywhere.

rows.title: v1.3.6 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🔍 ZOOM CLAMP — zooming into a landed world now stops before the ground texture smears into stripes.

rows.title: v1.3.6 🐛 Bug Fixes
rows.text: 🎲 RIGGED ROLLS — training rolls can no longer fail. A practice breed used to be able to lose its roll, consume both parents, and strand the lesson; rigged rolls now beat any odds.

rows.title: v1.3.6 🐛 Bug Fixes
rows.text: 🌍 EARTH BIOME — Earth no longer introduces itself as a savanna world; home keeps its true card.

rows.title: v1.3.5 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🏞 BIOMES — every world now wears a biome (~35 kinds: swamp worlds, coral shallows, glass deserts, magma seas, carbon worlds, storm-eye giants, and more), named on the survey card and painted into the landing view. Rare biomes are flagged in violet.

rows.title: v1.3.5 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🎯 LANDING ODDS — every world sits on a success ladder shown before you commit (a meadow world near-certain, a magma sea ~1 in 10). A failed descent bounces you back to orbit with a scrape, never worse — and each attempt improves the next try on that world. Visited worlds are permanent; return landings never ask again.

rows.title: v1.3.5 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: ⚠ DESCENT CONFIRM — a manual dive into an unvisited world stops at approach altitude and asks first; the survey card’s Land button skips the ask.

rows.title: v1.3.5 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🪐 GAS GIANT LANDINGS — the landing site is the high cloud deck: storm bands, the great spot when the card carries one, rings overhead, deep lightning, and aerial life drifting past where the card grants it.

rows.title: v1.3.5 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🌩 WEATHER EVENTS — tornadoes, hurricane walls at sea, sand walls, ice storms, erupting cryogeysers, acid rain that boils off mid-air over Venus-likes, volcanic lightning, fire whirls, iron rain on ember giants — each shown on the surface readout, in the landing view, and on the descent ask.

rows.title: v1.3.5 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🦠 EXTREMOPHILE LIFE — a thin slice of hostile worlds (molten, frozen, crushing, airless-adjacent) carries real creatures beyond microbes; the orbital glance flags them in violet as impossible biosignatures.

rows.title: v1.3.5 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🐋 LEVIATHAN SIGHTINGS — a world whose roster hides a titanic creature can render it at full scale on the landing-view horizon.

rows.title: v1.3.5 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🌊 ABYSSAL LANDINGS — abyssal ocean worlds render underwater: light shafts, glowing plankton, distant vent fire, and lure-bearing deep hunters where the card grants them.

rows.title: v1.3.5 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🌿 MARINE & EXTREMOPHILE FLORA — ocean worlds grow kelp towers, seagrass meadows, reef-builders, and sargassum rafts; aerial-life worlds gain drifting veils; and extremophile creatures earn habitat behaviors — vent-clingers, magma-swimmers, storm-riders, winged hunters.

rows.title: v1.3.5 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🪟 ONE PANEL RULE — opening a panel closes the previous one, phone and desktop alike; every panel carries a corner ✕, and tapping empty space closes the open one. Duels, reveals, and dialogs are exempt from stray-tap close.

rows.title: v1.3.5 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: ✕ LANDING VIEW CLOSE — the landing view carries a ✕, and a quick tap right after reopening can no longer strand it open.

rows.title: v1.3.5 🖱 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🎨 ORBIT COLOR MATCH — orbital art now matches the biome: carbon worlds graphite-dark, obsidian worlds near-black, magma seas glowing warm, blue-ice worlds cold, ember giants red.

rows.title: v1.3.5 ⚖ Balancing
rows.text: 🌩 STORM MODIFIER — an active storm adds 5 points of landing difficulty — never enough to trouble a friendly world.

rows.title: v1.3.5 ⚖ Balancing
rows.text: 📋 NEW WEEKLY CHARTER — “Down the hard way” pays 35 ☄ for landing on a gas giant, hothouse, or molten world; adding it reshuffles the weekly board once at the next rollover.

rows.title: v1.3.5 🐛 Bug Fixes
rows.text: 💫 REMNANT RENDERING — the dashes around supernova remnants and the drawn circles around cosmic deaths are gone; everything that dies in space now renders as a cloud.

rows.title: v1.3.5 🐛 Bug Fixes
rows.text: 🪐 GAS GIANT READOUT — gas giant surfaces no longer report themselves as airless with no weather.

rows.title: v1.3.5 🔧 Under the Hood
rows.text: ⚡ GALAXY RENDER — remnant and merger gradients are baked once instead of allocated every frame — lower battery draw on phones.

rows.title: v1.3.5 🔧 Under the Hood
rows.text: 💾 WAVE-OFF PERSISTENCE — wave-off progress on hard worlds saves with the expedition, so a reload keeps the climb.

rows.title: v1.3 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🏞 LANDING VISTAS — landing opens a painted surface view drawn straight from the survey card: terrain, weather, time of day, inhabitants, and nearby fauna. The card’s Landing vista button reopens it anytime.

rows.title: v1.3 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🎨 PER-WORLD VARIATION — horizon, sun, rivers, and plants all roll per world, with palettes that run to golden, copper, and violet forests. Rare touches: sky-spanning rings, a huge low moon, glowing shores.

rows.title: v1.3 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🐾 CREATURE PORTRAITS — Compendium art now matches the card’s traits: tentacled creatures have tentacles, armored ones plates, eyeless ones no eyes. Apex Guardians wear a molten-gold aura; Paragons a silver-teal one.

rows.title: v1.3 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🌦 WEATHER CYCLES — rain showers and dust storms pass now instead of running forever, and the readout reports clear skies between spells. Snow still lingers in cold country.

rows.title: v1.3 🎨 UI Enhancements
rows.text: ⭐ STAR RENDERING — galaxy-view stars glow in true class colors with halos, spikes on the giants, and a twinkle on the brightest; nebulae, dark clouds, and supernova remnants gain real texture instead of flat circles.

rows.title: v1.3 🎨 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🪐 PLANET ART — the art now honors the survey card: dried seas and salt flats on hot worlds, ice on frozen ones, era-based night lights on civilized worlds, rings on card thumbnails, true moon colors, and per-star lighting in every system.

rows.title: v1.3 🎨 UI Enhancements
rows.text: ✨ REVEAL SCALING — the discovery cinematic now escalates past Mythic all the way to the summit; the rarest creatures wear foil in the Compendium list, a caught Paragon’s Binder slot takes its true grade color, and Silicon earns its own icon color.

rows.title: v1.3 🎨 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🃏 CARD HANDLING — locked cards carry an ✕ (tapping empty space still closes them), and any open card drags by its header , mouse or finger.

rows.title: v1.2.6 🎨 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🖋 EMPHASIS PASS — bold now marks only pressable items and proper names: some ~100 stray emphasis words across cards, battles, training, and these very notes reverted to plain text. In the brighter Text tones, gold marks the interactive bits.

rows.title: v1.2.6 🎨 UI Enhancements
rows.text: ⚔ BATTLE LOG COLORS — a MUD-style color language: champion cyan, foe ember, damage yellow, crits gold, misses dim, burns orange, mending green, lifesteal violet, thorns lime, deaths red — victory prints gold, defeat red. Shared battle logs stay plain text.

rows.title: v1.2.6 🎨 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🎨 SYSTEM COLOR LANGUAGE — pop-ups and the bell tray now speak in color: red for harm, gold for milestones, green for gains. Long-range glances tint their readings (water cyan, life green, signals violet), the Compendium marks the Field Scout cyan, and Star Atlas and Cosmic Events follow suit.

rows.title: v1.2.6 🎨 UI Enhancements
rows.text: ✍ COPY PASS — a full grammar and clarity sweep: stale button names corrected, the settings guide updated to its three tabs, one stray “Codex” label returned to the Prime Codex, and the First Contact achievement renamed First Specimen (the real first contact keeps its name).

rows.title: v1.2.5 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🤝 FIRST CONTACT — landing on an inhabited world now attempts contact: a warm reception opens the census on the spot; a wary one wounds you and seals the census until your next landing; a named Field Scout takes that hit in your place. Conquered worlds skip contact entirely.

rows.title: v1.2.5 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 📦 CARGO GRID — the Cargo hold is a real inventory grid now, with per-element icons: ingots for metals, shards for ices, flasks for gases, cut gems for exotics. The Research Bench moves to its own tab, carrying the same icons into every recipe.

rows.title: v1.2.5 🎨 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🛬 ONE LAND BUTTON — every world’s card shows a single Land button now; what happens next depends on the world. Manual zoom-in still works.

rows.title: v1.2.5 🐞 Bug Fixes
rows.text: 🩹 CARD OVERFLOW — expanding a survey card’s Environment fold could push it off-screen with no way to scroll; the card now resizes and repositions itself as it unfolds.

rows.title: v1.2.1 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 📋 EXPEDITION CHARTERS — a hunt board joins the left rail. New explorers get five starter charters that chain the core trades in order — make planetfall, prospect a dead world, discover life, name a Field Scout, conquer a world — each paying ☄ Stardust on completion. A veteran’s already-proven trades arrive marked complete.

rows.title: v1.2.1 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🗓 WEEKLY BOARD — once the trades are learned, three fresh charters arrive each week, identical for every explorer in the universe.

rows.title: v1.2 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🔎 THREE-STEP DISCOVERY — knowing a world comes in three tiers: a glance shows telescope reads (color class, atmosphere, water signatures, biosignatures, ⟁ signals — hover on desktop; on phone a tap goes straight to survey); the orbital survey reads environment and biosphere; and planetfall runs the full ground survey.

rows.title: v1.2 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🛬 LAND BUTTONS — an unlanded world carries one right on its card: Land — make contact on civilized worlds, Land to prospect on dead ones. One press flies you down; manual zoom-in still works.

rows.title: v1.2 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🤝 CIVILIZATION READS — a civilization can’t be read from orbit (you get ⟁ signals only); land and make contact to learn its tech era, calendar, and population.

rows.title: v1.2 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: ⛏ PROSPECTING GATE — a dead world’s ⛏ Mine Deposits unlocks only after you’ve landed on it; 🛰 Deep Scanners still read its veins from orbit.

rows.title: v1.2 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: ✅ GROUND-SURVEYED MARK — a visited world now carries a Ground-surveyed mark; every world you’d charted, settled, or mined before this update counts as ground-surveyed already (nothing known is re-hidden).

rows.title: v1.2 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: ⛳ FIELD SAMPLES — your first footfall on any world collects samples: a pinch of its elements plus a few ☄ Stardust, richer on rarer worlds.

rows.title: v1.2 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🐾 FIELD SCOUTS — press Scout on a fauna card to name your expedition’s scout; it soaks hostile bioscan hits through the standard wounds-and-mending system, and is lost forever at zero. Tougher scouts open deadlier worlds.

rows.title: v1.2 🛠 Under the Hood
rows.text: ⚡ PHONE PERFORMANCE — the star field is painted once instead of every frame, survey readouts stop recomputing sixty times a second, card layout no longer thrashes, and phones render at a tuned resolution.

rows.title: v1.2 🎨 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🧭 SURVEY HEADINGS — heading emoji removed and alignment tidied; fold rows now read expand / close instead of a small triangle.

rows.title: v1.2 🐞 Bug Fixes
rows.text: 🌍 EARTH MINING — Earth no longer offers ⛏ Mine Deposits ; it was the only living world with a mining action, a quirk of how home’s card is built. The dead worlds are where the elements live.

rows.title: v1.1.2 🎨 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🃏 SURVEY CARDS CONDENSED — actions on top, then rarity, life, and civilization; the environmental survey (atmosphere, climate, water, gravity, and more) folds behind a 🌍 chevron, and the census (tech era, calendar, population) behind its headline. Your fold choices are remembered.

rows.title: v1.1.2 🎨 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🔝 CARD ACTIONS — Star Atlas, Conquer, Mine, and Share now sit at the top of every survey card.

rows.title: v1.1.2 🎨 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 📜 VISIBLE SCROLLBARS — every scrolling panel (release notes, survey cards, Guide, Compendium, and more) now shows a visible thumb on a faint track.

rows.title: v1.1.2 🎨 UI Enhancements
rows.text: ⚙ SETTINGS WIDTH — the panel is wider now, and option pills can no longer overflow its right edge at any font size.

rows.title: v1.1.2 🎨 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 📰 BULLETIN CONTEXT — the “What’s new” bulletin carries its whole release line (1.1.2 shows the 1.1.1 and 1.1 notes beneath it).

rows.title: v1.1.1 🎨 UI Enhancements
rows.text: ⚙ SETTINGS SPACING — option pills keep a clean gap from their labels now (Font and Motion had been touching).

rows.title: v1.1.1 🛠 Under the Hood
rows.text: 🏷 EXTERNAL NAMING — the browser tab, link previews, and search results all say Celestial Frontier now; the old “Cosmic Codex” page subtitle is retired (the Prime Codex keeps its name).

rows.title: v1.1 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🔊 CORE SOUND EFFECTS — a sonar ping on survey taps; a whoosh on hyperlane travel and planetfall.

rows.title: v1.1 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: 🎚 SOUND VOLUME SLIDER — Settings → Audio: one master level for every effect.

rows.title: v1.1 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: ♿ MOTION SETTING — Settings → Graphics: Auto honors the device’s reduce-motion preference (and keeps listening for it); Full / Reduced override. Reduced stills the travel tunnel, screen shake, confetti, and foil shimmer.

rows.title: v1.1 ✨ New Features & Systems
rows.text: ✎ EXPLORER RENAME — Settings → Display → Explorer name, or the ✎ link atop the character sheet; your record persists, only the name changes.

rows.title: v1.1 🎨 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🤫 QUIET TRAINING — during Field Training, pop-ups rest in the 🔔 tray (nothing is lost) and tooltips hold; a blocked scroll nudges the guidance card instead of failing silently.

rows.title: v1.1 🎨 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🔠 LABEL SCALING — survey-card labels are brighter and now scale with the A+ / A++ text sizes.

rows.title: v1.1 🎨 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 🖱 DESKTOP HINT — corrected: hovering previews a card, a click surveys it.

rows.title: v1.1 🎨 UI Enhancements
rows.text: 👆 TOUCH TARGETS — everything tappable in the sky, plus the small Atlas and Settings controls, gained larger hit areas — no visual change.

rows.title: v1.1 🎨 UI Enhancements
rows.text: ⌨ KEYBOARD SUPPORT — Settings, Compendium, Binder, Star Atlas, and Guide entries are tabbable and fire on Enter or Space, each with a visible focus ring.

rows.title: v1.1 🚀 Gameplay
rows.text: 🛬 LANDING ASSIST — zooming into a view-filling, off-center planet glides the camera the rest of the way and lands, instead of silently maxing out; only a deliberate zoom-in triggers it (panning, pinching, and moon-gazing are never hijacked).

rows.title: v1.1 🐞 Bug Fixes
rows.text: 🌙 MOON TAP TARGETS — tiny moons no longer steal taps aimed at their planet (“tap Earth” lands on Earth): a moon’s tap target matches its visible size, the generous grab returns up close, and planet targets grew a little.

rows.title: v1.1 🐞 Bug Fixes
rows.text: 🎓 TRAINING RANK UP — the sandbox promotion is handed back with the practice cache; the real Rank Up fanfare waits for the real thing.

rows.title: v1.1 🐞 Bug Fixes
rows.text: ✎ RENAME DIALOG — closes with Esc or Cancel now instead of demanding a name.

rows.title: v1.1 🛠 Under the Hood
rows.text: 📰 WELCOME BULLETIN — pinned to the shipped version’s notes, so a fresh expedition always opens on the game overview, never a work-in-progress changelog.

rows.title: v1.0 🌌 An Infinite, Shared Universe
rows.text: 🌱 DETERMINISTIC COSMOS — every galaxy, star, and world is grown from seeds, identical for every explorer, fully offline, no account needed. Four seamless scales: universe → galaxy → star system → planet surface.

rows.title: v1.0 🌌 An Infinite, Shared Universe
rows.text: 🚀 HYPERLANE TRAVEL — jump time scales with distance, and researched drives cut it sharply. The travel tunnel takes on the destination’s light; tap to skip.

rows.title: v1.0 🌌 An Infinite, Shared Universe
rows.text: 🃏 SURVEY CARDS — for worlds, stars, black holes, wormholes, supernovae, and the cosmic microwave background alike, each with a spectral designation color-coded by rarity.

rows.title: v1.0 🌌 An Infinite, Shared Universe
rows.text: 🗺 FRONTIER REGIONS — the charter begins at the Solar Reach and widens with each Signature claimed: Local Cluster, Near Field, Deep Field, Outer Dark, Frontier. The farther out you reach, the tougher the defenders and the stranger the life.

rows.title: v1.0 🌌 An Infinite, Shared Universe
rows.text: 🌠 COSMIC EVENTS — events on every timescale, cycling by the hour, week, month, and year, identical for every explorer at the same moment; the 📜 Witness Log keeps them all.

rows.title: v1.0 🧭 The Explorer’s Tools
rows.text: 🧭 NAVIGATION TOOLS — the Star Atlas bookmarks worlds with favorites and a home marker; search spans everything you’ve discovered or named, and accepts pasted codes; and the Traveler’s Beacon posts a shared destination every five minutes.

rows.title: v1.0 🧭 The Explorer’s Tools
rows.text: 🔗 SHARE CODES — CF1- codes land a friend on your exact world; CFB- codes summon your exact creature for a duel; and 📸 discovery records export Legendary-or-better finds as paste-anywhere keepsakes.

rows.title: v1.0 🧭 The Explorer’s Tools
rows.text: 🎓 FIELD TRAINING — a fully sandboxed tutorial for every new expedition: chart Earth, train with a loaned cache, feed, breed, duel, take a scratch, heal. Skippable for veterans, and nothing from training ever carries out.

rows.title: v1.0 🧭 The Explorer’s Tools
rows.text: 📖 THE GUIDE — a searchable 🧭 Guide to the Universe covering every system; open it with ? anytime (its version line opens these very notes).

rows.title: v1.0 🧬 Life & the Compendium
rows.text: ⚗ THE COMPENDIUM — catalogue life across four kingdoms and sixteen realms; a painterly portrait engine stages every creature in the habitat where you found it.

rows.title: v1.0 🧬 Life & the Compendium
rows.text: 🏅 RARITY LADDER — a deep rarity ladder runs from Common up to a one-in-a-million summit, with foil frames at the very top. Once earned, a grade never falls.

rows.title: v1.0 🧬 Life & the Compendium
rows.text: 🧬 BREEDING & FEEDING — Breed hybrids (both parents are consumed) and feed for permanent growth and medicine; rarer flora poison deeper, and only a spent beast dies of it.

rows.title: v1.0 🧬 Life & the Compendium
rows.text: 👑 APEX GUARDIANS — named, one-of-a-kind summit titans rule rare worlds — the same rulers for every explorer — and defeating one in conquest adds it to your Compendium.

rows.title: v1.0 🧬 Life & the Compendium
rows.text: 🜲 THE FIFTY PARAGONS — legendary deep-spectrum creatures wait on fixed worlds, shown as Binder silhouettes until found; share the coordinates and every explorer faces the same legend.

rows.title: v1.0 🧬 Life & the Compendium
rows.text: 🌱 LIVING COLLECTION — the Compendium interbreeds and evolves on the cosmic clock, and worlds re-roll their rosters as the universe ages. Sapience runs from Instinctive to fully Sapient, and worlds host civilizations from stone-age to starfaring.

rows.title: v1.0 ⚔ Battle
rows.text: ⚔ CLASSES & LEVELS — every beast is born to one of 180+ classes (Warrior to Worldbreaker, the legendary ones reserved for the summit) with innate, always-on arts. XP comes only from wins — duels, conquests, guardians — and levels wake more arts; raw stats never inflate on their own.

rows.title: v1.0 ⚔ Battle
rows.text: ✨ ABILITY MATRIX — hundreds of arts (“Fire Reckoning III”) balanced across thousands of simulated duels; hybrids inherit the other parent’s archetype, and guardians fight with Sovereign arts.

rows.title: v1.0 ⚔ Battle
rows.text: 📜 THE CHRONICLE — duels are narrated blow-by-blow: initiative, named arts, executes, thorn recoils, burn ticks, death lines — closing with a statistics ledger and a shareable battle log.

rows.title: v1.0 ⚔ Battle
rows.text: 🏴 CONQUEST — champion a world yourself or send a beast; settled worlds fly your flag, scan safely, and pay Stardust, and a world’s home field lets its defenders fight in their element.

rows.title: v1.0 ⚔ Battle
rows.text: 🩹 PERSISTENT WOUNDS — conquest scars and resented meals leave a beast Bruised, Injured, or Critical, fighting below strength until mended; feeding is medicine (loved flavours mend most, rarer flora mend deeper — and poison harder). Hostile bioscans cost you explorer HP, and zero HP ends the expedition.

rows.title: v1.0 🛠 Progression
rows.text: 🔑 THE PRIME CODEX — nine elemental Signatures, each guarded by a named titan; master all nine to command the forces of the universe and open the Celestial Frontier — with multiple endings.

rows.title: v1.0 🛠 Progression
rows.text: ⛏ MINING & RESEARCH — dead worlds carry the elements; stock the 🧰 Cargo and spend at the bench on scanners, hull, lab, and the drive ladder (Fusion → Antimatter → Warp Fold).

rows.title: v1.0 🛠 Progression
rows.text: 🗂 THE BINDER — collect types, not individuals: fixed pages, identical for every explorer, with claimable Sets that pay Stardust bounties.

rows.title: v1.0 🛠 Progression
rows.text: 🏆 RANKS & RECORDS — ten explorer ranks with unlockable nameplate colors (foil at Eternal Frontier), dozens of achievements, the Star Atlas, the Traveler’s Beacon, cosmic events with their 📜 Witness Log, 📸 discovery records, and share codes for worlds and creatures alike.

rows.title: v1.0 ⚙ The Craft
rows.text: 📱 PLATFORM — one file, offline-capable, mobile-first, and deterministic to the byte: the same universe on every device, verified by a 50-probe fingerprint and a full headless test fleet on every build.

rows.title: v1.0 ⚙ The Craft
rows.text: ⚙ OPTIONS — Display / Graphics / Audio tabs: text size, tone, font, tooltips, effects, shake, sound, notifications — all persistent. The version line under ? opens these notes. Saves are browser-local; back up favorites as ⇪ creature codes.

misread.title: v1.7.0 ⚖ Balancing
misread.text: 🧬 BLOODLINES WITH A HORIZON — breeding and feeding still grow a champion without limit in spirit, but the deepest grinds now approach a ceiling (~2.5× a Titan) instead of dwarfing every fight in the game. No real bloodline in the wild loses a single point.

misread.title: v1.8.3 🐛 Bug Fixes
misread.text: 🧬 A UNION’S EXPERIENCE REACHES THE CHILD — both parents are consumed by breeding, and the experience was being paid to one of them, so it vanished the moment it was earned. The newborn now carries it: +2 for the union, +5 the first time you cross two particular species. (That bonus also only ever recognised “fauna with fauna” before, so it never meant what it said.)

misread.title: v1.8.4 🐛 Bug Fixes
misread.text: 🧬 A UNION’S EXPERIENCE REACHES THE CHILD — both parents are consumed by breeding, and the experience was paid to one of them, so it vanished as it was earned. The newborn carries it now: +2 for the union, +5 the first time you cross two particular species.
